ValidationRule.description: Residency Permit Expiry Date is Mandatory for periodic Review Case if Residency permit photo required is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Periodic Review"), ISCHANGED(cc_Residence_Permit_Expiry_Date__c), OR( ISBLANK(cc_Residence_Permit_Expiry_Date__c), cc_Residence_Permit_Expiry_Date__c < TODAY() ), pr_ResidencyPermitPhotoRequired__c = true )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Resident Expiry date field and it should be greater then today's date.
